instruction: Create release.tar.gz from dist and README.md using gzip compression.
context: tar: -c creates an archive, -z selects gzip, and -f takes the exact archive path before input operands.

instruction: List files in backup.tgz verbosely without extracting them.
context: tar: -t lists without extraction, -z handles gzip, -v is verbose, and -f takes the archive operand.

instruction: Extract logs.tar.xz into restored while preserving the archive.
context: tar: -x extracts, -J selects xz, -f takes the archive path, and -C takes the destination directory.

instruction: Compare files in snapshot.tar with the current filesystem and report differences.
context: tar: -d compares archive members against the filesystem; -f takes the exact archive path.

instruction: Download https://example.com/app.tgz to package.tgz with three retries.
context: wget: --tries takes the attempt count and --output-document takes the requested local filename.

instruction: Resume downloading https://example.com/image.iso and save it under downloads.
context: wget: --continue resumes a partial file and --directory-prefix takes the exact destination directory.

instruction: Fetch https://example.com/index.html with a ten-second timeout without overwriting an existing file.
context: wget: --timeout sets network timeout seconds and --no-clobber prevents replacing an existing local file.

instruction: Mirror https://docs.example.com while excluding its private directory.
context: wget: --mirror enables recursive timestamped mirroring and --reject-regex excludes matching URLs.

instruction: Show a brief summary of addresses on every network interface.
context: ip: --brief selects compact output; address show is the requested object and action.

instruction: Show which route the kernel would use for 203.0.113.8.
context: ip route get performs a route lookup for the exact destination operand without changing routes.

instruction: Bring network interface enp3s0 down.
response: ip link set dev enp3s0 down
context: ip link set changes link state; dev takes the exact interface name and down is the requested state.

instruction: Display detailed traffic statistics for interface wlan0.
context: ip: -stats requests counters; link show dev selects the exact interface without modifying it.

instruction: List listening TCP sockets numerically and show owning processes.
context: ss: -l selects listening sockets, -n numeric output, -t TCP, and -p owning processes.

instruction: List all UDP sockets with numeric addresses.
context: ss: -u selects UDP, -a all states, and -n prevents service-name resolution.

instruction: Show only established TCP connections.
context: ss: -t selects TCP and state established is the exact state filter.

instruction: Show listening TCP sockets whose local port is 443.
context: ss: -ltn selects numeric listening TCP sockets; the quoted filter restricts the local source port.

instruction: Run the test target in build using eight parallel jobs.
context: make: -C takes the working directory, -j takes the job count, and test is the requested target.

instruction: Preview the deploy target with ENV set to staging without executing recipes.
context: make: --dry-run prints recipes without running them; deploy and ENV=staging preserve the requested target and assignment.

instruction: Build the release target using packaging.mk.
context: make: --file takes the exact makefile path and release is the requested target.

instruction: Build clean and all while continuing after independent errors.
context: make: --keep-going continues independent work after errors; clean and all are two requested targets in order.

instruction: Run the test script and pass runInBand to the underlying test runner.
context: npm test runs the test script; bare -- separates arguments forwarded to the script.

instruction: Install eslint as a development dependency.
context: npm install adds a package and --save-dev records the exact package operand in devDependencies.

instruction: Run the build script and pass production mode to it.
context: npm run build selects the build script; arguments after -- are passed to that script in order.

instruction: Report outdated dependencies as JSON without updating anything.
context: npm outdated reports available versions without installing them and --json selects machine-readable output.

instruction: Configure the current source into build as a Release build.
context: cmake: -S takes source, -B takes build directory, and -D sets the exact cache variable.

instruction: Build target shelliq from build using eight parallel jobs.
context: cmake --build takes the build tree, --target the exact target, and --parallel the job count.

instruction: Install the build tree under /opt/widget.
context: cmake --install selects the build tree and --prefix takes the exact installation prefix.

instruction: Clean first then build the Debug configuration from out.
context: cmake --build takes the exact build tree; --config selects Debug and --clean-first preserves the requested ordering.

instruction: Run nginx:latest detached as web, mapping host port 8080 to container port 80.
context: podman run: --detach backgrounds, --name takes the requested name, and --publish takes host:container ports before image.

instruction: Follow api container logs starting with its last fifty lines.
context: podman logs: --follow streams new output, --tail takes count, and api is the exact container operand.

instruction: Run env non-interactively inside worker container.
context: podman exec takes the exact container followed by the command; interactive and terminal flags are unnecessary.

instruction: Inspect the container named frontend and require the object to be a container.
context: podman inspect: --type restricts object kind and frontend is the exact requested container name.

instruction: Open app.db read-only with column headers and list active users.
response: sqlite3 -readonly -header app.db 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE active = 1;'
context: sqlite3: -readonly prevents writes, -header labels columns, then database and exact SQL are operands.

instruction: Export the id and email columns from users in app.db as CSV to users.csv.
response: sqlite3 -header -csv app.db 'SELECT id, email FROM users;' > users.csv
context: sqlite3: -header and -csv select output shape; redirection preserves the exact requested output path.

instruction: Apply migration.sql to app.db and stop at the first SQL error.
context: sqlite3: -bail stops after an error; input redirection reads the exact requested script into the exact database.

instruction: Show the number of queued jobs in jobs.db using line output mode.
response: sqlite3 -line jobs.db "SELECT count(*) AS queued FROM jobs WHERE state = 'queued';"
context: sqlite3: -line selects line mode; jobs.db and the count query preserve the requested database, table, alias, and state.

instruction: Compress dataset.json at level 19 while keeping the original file.
context: zstd: -19 selects compression level, --keep retains the input, and dataset.json is the exact operand.

instruction: Decompress archive.zst to restored.tar.
context: zstd: --decompress selects decoding and -o takes the requested destination before the input operand.

instruction: Test backup.zst for corruption without writing decompressed output.
context: zstd: --test checks compressed data integrity without producing a decompressed file.

instruction: Compress database.dump using all CPU threads and write database.dump.zst.
context: zstd: -T0 uses detected cores and -o binds the exact destination separately from input.

instruction: Install build/tool as /usr/local/bin/widget with mode 0755, creating parent directories.
context: install: -D creates leading directories, -m takes the exact mode, followed by source and destination operands.

instruction: Create /srv/cache as a directory owned by deploy with mode 0750.
context: install: -d creates directories, -o takes owner, -m takes mode, and the path remains the requested operand.

instruction: Install app.conf over /etc/widget/app.conf with mode 0644 and back up an existing destination with suffix .old.
context: install: -b enables backup, -S takes suffix, -m takes mode, then exact source and destination follow.

instruction: Install server into /opt/widget/bin/server owned by group operators and strip symbols.
context: install: -D creates parents, -g takes group, -s strips symbols, then exact source and destination operands follow.

instruction: Run backup.sh for at most thirty seconds, send TERM first, then KILL five seconds later.
context: timeout: --signal sets first signal, --kill-after sets grace period, then duration and exact command follow.

instruction: Limit worker --once to two minutes while preserving its exit status when possible.
context: timeout: --preserve-status retains command status; duration precedes the exact command and its argument.

instruction: Run interactive-client in the foreground with a ten-second limit.
context: timeout: --foreground permits terminal access; duration and exact command operand remain separate.

instruction: Run poller staging for forty-five seconds, report timeout signals, and use INT on expiry.
context: timeout: --verbose diagnoses sent signals, --signal=INT selects expiry signal, then duration, command, and exact argument follow.
